items.text: Fixed terrain clipping in Nuclear Missile Silo doorways and underground tunnels, preventing doors from being blocked by terrain.
Encryption level is now applied on the network thread, preventing premature encryption setup and ensuring packet batches are flushed before sending, reducing connection errors.
DirectDraw objects no longer render when attached to entities that haven’t been networked to the client yet, fixing visual glitches.

2026-11-07.summary:
### Monuments & World
- Fixed terrain clipping in Nuclear Missile Silo doorways and underground tunnels, preventing doors from being blocked by terrain.

### Bug Fixes
- Encryption level is now applied on the network thread, preventing premature encryption setup and ensuring packet batches are flushed before sending, reducing connection errors.
- DirectDraw objects no longer render when attached to entities that haven’t been networked to the client yet, fixing visual glitches.

items.text: Night vision goggles no longer get stuck and function reliably; scientists' NVG suit eyes now glow correctly after trophy interactions.
Overly bright flares in the Floating City have been toned down and flares now support longer distances, reducing glare.
Fixed caching of null data for missing files, reducing load errors and improving overall game stability.

2026-11-06.summary:
### Gear
- Night vision goggles no longer get stuck and function reliably; scientists' NVG suit eyes now glow correctly after trophy interactions.

### Lighting & Visuals
- Overly bright flares in the Floating City have been toned down and flares now support longer distances, reducing glare.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Fixed caching of null data for missing files, reducing load errors and improving overall game stability.
